title: 第13章 效果出来了第14章 有人在装逼
slug: 乡村大炮第296章先宣传一波
content_zh:
李大炮只觉得一阵香风袭来，看到眼前的黑丝美女周念瑶，没想到她竟然还跟过来了。
“你的这些黄龙瓜，我全要了。”
周念瑶说道，管它是黄瓜，还是黄龙瓜，就当报答他的恩情。
“你全都要了？这么多，你吃得完吗？”
李大炮问道，没看出来，这女人还挺知恩图报。
“小看我了不是，我在镇里开了一个农家乐，这些黄龙瓜肯定能卖完。”
周念瑶说道，虽然她现在生意不景气，但感觉自己怎么样也比李大炮条件更好一些。
“这样啊，那感情好，你的农家乐在哪里？我把这些黄龙瓜全都给你送过去。”李大炮说道。
“就在前方不远处，你跟我来，我带你过去。”
周念瑶说道，随后转身向着前方走去。
李大炮立即蹬着三轮车跟了上去，今天遇上大客户了，回去跟孟晚晴也算有一个交代。
暗中有一双怨毒的眼睛一直盯着李大炮，他就是逼哥，被打了之后，并没有走远，而是躲在暗中，如隐藏的毒蛇。
“妈的，在这大黑驴镇，只有我欺负别人的份，给我好好的去调查一下，那个小子到底是什么来头？”
逼哥喝道，随后倒吸一口冷气，因为被李大炮揍的有点惨。
他一转身，结果碰到了牛犊子村的李大柱。
李大柱是特意来找逼哥帮他出头的，在村里被李大炮踹了两脚，感觉三魂七魄都丢了俩。
他咽不下这口气，特意来找逼哥帮他报仇。
“逼哥。”
李大柱立即露出讨好的笑容，看着他们几个一个个呲牙咧嘴的样子，不知道这是怎么了。
“大柱啊，有事吗？”逼哥问道。

“逼哥，我在村里被人打了，我想请逼哥帮我出头，事成之后我一定好好感谢逼哥。”
李大柱说道，他完全不知道，逼哥几个人刚刚被李大炮揍了一顿。
“什么？李大柱，你可真是越混越回去了，老子在这当乡霸，你好歹也算个村霸，在村里还能被别人给打了。”
逼哥开口嘲讽，完全不提自己刚刚被打的事。
“逼哥，那小子是一个傻子，人虽然傻，但是力气却贼大，我一个人不是他的对手，只能找逼哥帮忙。”李大柱说道。
“行吧，找我办事可以，规矩你懂的。”逼哥说道。
“我懂，我懂，事成之后一定好好感谢逼哥，我买了几个硬菜，中午先吃好喝好，然后再办事。”
李大柱非常殷勤，他已经迫不及待想要报仇。
逼哥答应下来，随后带着小弟，跟着他回牛犊子村。
李大炮这边，也来到了周念瑶的农家乐。
她的农家乐还是挺有特色的，里面养了鸡鸭，还有鱼塘，甚至还种了不少农产品。
“对了，还不知道你叫什么名字呢？”周念瑶问道。
“我叫，我叫李大炮。”
李大炮回道，反正他也习惯了这个名字，真名叫啥也都不重要了。
“李大炮。”
周念瑶一阵愣神，随后说道：“你这名字起的挺霸气的，我叫周念瑶。”
“一般一般，老板娘，你这生意应该挺不错的吧？”李大炮问道。
“还行吧。”
content_en:
Li Dapao felt a gust of fragrant wind blowing over him. When he saw the black stocking beauty Zhou Nianyao in front of him, he didn't expect that she would follow him.
"I want all of your yellow dragon melons."
Zhou Nianyao said, no matter whether it is a cucumber or a yellow dragon melon, you should repay his kindness.
"You want them all? It's so much, can you finish it?"
Li Dapao asked, not realizing that this woman was quite repaying her kindness.
"You're underestimating me, aren't you? I've opened a farmhouse in the town, and these yellow dragon melons will definitely be sold out."
Zhou Nianyao said that although her business is currently in a slump, she feels that her conditions are better than Li Dapao.
"That's it. That's a good relationship. Where is your farmhouse? I'll send you all these yellow dragon melons." Li Dapao said.
"It's not far ahead. Come with me and I'll take you there."
Zhou Nianyao said, then turned and walked forward.
Li Dapao immediately followed him on his tricycle. He met a big client today, and he wanted to have an explanation with Meng Wanqing when he went back.
There was a pair of malicious eyes staring at Li Dapao in the dark. He was Brother Bi. After being beaten, he did not go far, but hid in the dark, like a hidden poisonous snake.
"Damn it, in this big black donkey town, I am the only one who bullies others. Let me investigate carefully. Who is that kid?"
Brother Bi shouted, and then took a breath of air, because he was beaten badly by Li Dapao.
He turned around and bumped into Li Dazhu from Niuduzi Village.
Li Dazhu came specifically to find Brother Bian to help him stand out. He was kicked twice by Li Dapao in the village, and he felt that he had lost two of his souls and seven souls.
He couldn't swallow this breath, so he came to Brother Bi to help him take revenge.
"Brother forced."
Li Dazhu immediately showed a flattering smile and looked at them all grinning, wondering what was going on.
"Dazhu, is something wrong?" Brother Bi asked.
"Brother Bi, I was beaten in the village. I want to ask Brother Bi to help me. I will thank Brother Bi very much after the incident is completed."
Li Dazhu said that he had no idea that Brother Bi and the others had just been beaten up by Li Dapao.
"What? Li Dazhu, you are really getting better and better. I am a village bully here, but you are also a village bully. You can still be beaten by others in the village."
Brother forced him to mock, not mentioning the fact that he had just been beaten.
"Brother Bi, that kid is a fool. Although he is stupid, he is very strong. I am no match for him, so I can only ask Brother Bi for help." Li Dazhu said.
"Okay, you can come to me to do things. You know the rules." Brother Bi said.
"I understand, I understand. I will thank Brother Pa when everything is done. I bought some hard vegetables. I will eat and drink well at noon, and then I will do my work."
Li Dazhu is very attentive and he can't wait to take revenge.
Brother forced him to agree, and then took his younger brother and followed him back to Niuduzi Village.
Li Dapao also came to Zhou Nianyao's farmhouse.
Her farmhouse is quite unique. It raises chickens, ducks, fish ponds, and even grows a lot of agricultural products.
"By the way, I still don't know what your name is?" Zhou Nianyao asked.
"My name is Li Dapao."
Li Dapao replied that he was used to this name anyway, and it didn't matter what his real name was.
"Li Dapao."
Zhou Nianyao was stunned for a while, and then said: "Your name is quite domineering. My name is Zhou Nianyao."
"Just so so, boss lady, your business should be pretty good, right?" Li Dapao asked.
"It's okay."
